title: Savol va qisqa javob
hook_voice: Lesson nine. Are you? Yes, I am. No, I'm not.

example.en: Are you happy? Yes, I am.

end_say: Saqlab qo'ying! Ertaga o'ninchi dars: birdan o'ngacha sonlar.
caption:
0 dan ingliz tili, 9-dars: inglizcha «Are you ...? Yes, I am. No, I'm not».

Are you a student? — Siz talabamisiz?
Yes, I am — Ha, shunday
No, I'm not — Yo'q, emasman

Savol berish uchun "are" oldinga chiqadi: You are → Are you?
Saqlab qo'ying va ingliz tilini boshlamoqchi bo'lgan do'stingizga yuboring.
Ertaga 10-dars: Sonlar 1-10.
